name: obsidian-english-trainer
description: Look up English words with Russian translations, transcription and examples, collect them in general and per-book dictionaries from EPUB, FB2 and PDF books, and learn them with spaced repetition quizzes.

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && node esbuild.config.mjs production && node scripts/check-bundle.mjs
scripts.version: node scripts/version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json

author: ibn-arif
